note: From gcd(x,y,z)=1 derive pairwise coprimality. Exactly one of x,y is even; interchange to make y even, hence x,z odd. Set A=(z+x)/2 and B=(z-x)/2. Then A,B are positive coprime integers and AB=(y/2)^2, so each is a square. Write A=m^2, B=n^2; obtain formulas, coprimality, and opposite parity. Converse follows by expansion and ruling out every prime common divisor.
